- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:23086-23096 | severity=critical | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The WAVE_JUDGE Codex fallback has full filesystem write access despite serving a read-only verdict role.
  WHY: A prompt injection could modify the poller workspace before the post-call integrity check; severity ranged from MAJOR to BLOCKER, so BLOCKER is used.
- tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py:~1850-2010 | severity=low | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: History-fallback tests have stale names or assertions and no longer exercise the `git_history_verdict` integration they describe.
  WHY: Their bodies now test destination-resolution blocking, leaving history-fallback behavior insufficiently covered and misleading maintainers about the exercised path.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:517-519 | severity=high | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: `_push_targets` treats the first positional refspec as the push repository when `--repo` supplies the repository.
  WHY: A valid command such as `git push --repo=origin main:feature/x` can be blocked because the guard cannot resolve the refspec as a destination.
